title: Kenji's Roasted Potatoes
description: Fantastic roast potato recipie from The Food Lab.

ingredients.name: Russet Potatoes, cut into 1-2' cubes
ingredients.notes: Other other starchy potato like Idaho or Baking

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: or other fats like bacon or duck

steps: Adjust oven racks to the upper an dlower middle positions and preheat th eoven to 450F. Place potatoes in a large saucepan, cover with water by an inch, and season generously with salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, reduce to a simmer, and cook until a knife inserted meets barely any resistance (~10 min). Drain and transfer to a bowl.

Add the fat, and fresh cracked pepper. Vigerously toss potatoes well to coat par-boiled potatoes with starchy-fat film. Transfer potatoes to a baking sheet and roast until bottoms are cripst, rotating pan halfway though, about 25 minutes. To test doneness, attempty to pry a wedge from the pan, if there's lots of resistance, roast for an additional 3 mintues.
Flip all potatoes with a spatula, and continue to roast for an additional 25 mintues. Transfer to a servign bowl when finished, and and season withe with more salt pepper, and fresh herbs.
